title: Phase 1 nanostores store layer
description: Implement framework-agnostic nanostores for the shopping-list PWA Phase 1: categories, catalog (master item pool), active list (with checked state), history (shopping events only), user (name/photo with random defaults), and computed selectors for the main screen. Persistence via @nanostores/persistent. No tests/docs in this pass.

title: Implement Phase 1 nanostores module
description: Create src/stores/ with types.ts (shared shapes), categories.ts ($categories + add/rename/removeCategory), catalog.ts ($catalog + addItemToCatalog/editItem/removeItemFromCatalog), list.ts ($list + addToList/removeFromList/toggleChecked, logging history), history.ts ($history + logHistory), user.ts ($user + setUser/randomizeDefaults), selectors.ts (computed $itemsByCategory etc.), and index.ts (onMount seeding from items_categories.json + logger wiring). History logs ONLY add/remove-from-list; deletes/edits of catalog items and categories do NOT write history.

title: Store unit tests + 3-month history fixture
description: Add rstest unit tests for the src/stores/ nanostores layer (categories, catalog, list, history, user, selectors) and a generated random 3-month shopping-history fixture driven by docs/samples/items_categories.json. Tests run in happy-dom (persistentJSON needs localStorage); import store submodules directly, never the barrel. Each test resets stores via a shared helper. Verify with bun run test and bun run lint.

title: Test scaffolding + 3-month history fixture
description: Scaffolding: set environment:'happy-dom' in rstest.config.ts (verify exact key via rstest-best-practices skill). Create tests/fixtures/history.ts (sampleItems from items_categories.json, generateShoppingHistory(opts) spreading random add/remove events across 90 days with seedable PRNG, default export shoppingHistory3mo, buildSeedData() returning {categories,catalog,history}) and tests/fixtures/reset.ts (resetStores() clearing all stores + localStorage). Do NOT write the test files yet.

title: history.test.ts
description: Write tests/stores/history.test.ts: logHistory appends correct-shape HistoryEvent (id, timestamp, action, itemId, itemName, categoryId); clearHistory empties.

title: categories.test.ts
description: Write tests/stores/categories.test.ts: addCategory/renameCategory (uncategorized protected); removeCategory reassigns items to UNCATEGORIZED AND writes NO history.

title: selectors.test.ts
description: Write tests/stores/selectors.test.ts: $itemsByCategory groups active list by category preserving $categories order and dropping empty categories; $activeCategoryIds/$listCount/$checkedCount.

title: integration.test.ts
description: Write tests/stores/integration.test.ts: load buildSeedData() + shoppingHistory3mo, assert every history event's categoryId exists in categories and selectors stay consistent over realistic volume.

title: list.test.ts
description: Write tests/stores/list.test.ts covering core invariants: addToList adds entry + logs 'add'; no duplicate per itemId; no-op for unknown itemId; removeFromList removes entry + logs 'remove'; setEntryChecked toggles; createItemAndAddToList creates+adds+logs; removeListEntriesForItem cascade; setEntryChecked/clearList do NOT write history.

title: catalog.test.ts
description: Write tests/stores/catalog.test.ts: addCatalogItem/updateCatalogItem; removeCatalogItem cascades to $list AND writes NO history.

title: user.test.ts
description: Write tests/stores/user.test.ts: updateUser merges patch; randomUser returns a name from the pool + pravatar photo URL.

title: Create seed folder with shared typed loader
description: Add a repo-root `seed/` folder holding items_categories.json (relocated from docs/samples) and a `seed/index.ts` that normalizes the raw sample rows into typed store-shaped categories+catalog via stable deterministic ids. Repoint tests/fixtures/history.ts to consume the loader. Prerequisite for future dev seeding.

title: Create seed/ folder + typed loader + alias
Repoint history fixture to seed loader
Theme toggle (dark/light/system)
description: Add a persisted dark/light/system theme toggle to the app header. The project already wires a full dark palette via Tailwind v4's `.dark` class (src/styles/globals.css) but nothing applies it. Use Nanostores persistentAtom for state, an initTheme() side-effect to toggle the class + color-scheme and follow prefers-color-scheme for "system" mode, a ThemeToggle component built on the existing ToggleGroup primitive, and place it in the reserved header slot (src/App.tsx:18).

title: Add theme store + initTheme apply logic
description: Create src/stores/theme.ts exporting persistentAtom<"light"|"dark"|"system">("remindit:theme", "system") and an initTheme() side-effect that applies .dark/.light to document.documentElement, subscribes to matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)") for system mode, and sets color-scheme. Wire initTheme() into src/index.tsx before render (and/or initStores in src/stores/index.ts).

title: Add native color-scheme to globals.css
description: In src/styles/globals.css add `color-scheme: light dark;` to :root and the .dark block so native form controls/scrollbars follow the theme. Light defaults are already correct via :root tokens; do not disturb the existing accent .theme-* system in theme.css.

title: Build ThemeToggle component
description: Create src/components/theme-toggle.tsx using the existing ToggleGroup/ToggleGroupItem primitive (src/components/ui/toggle-group.tsx) with three segmented options Light/Dark/System, Phosphor icons (Sun/Moon/Monitor), bound via useStore to the theme store, accessible (aria-label, roles).

title: Place ThemeToggle in App header
description: In src/App.tsx replace the theme placeholder at line 18 with inside the existing header bar.

title: Add theme store + component tests
description: Create src/stores/theme.test.ts (Rstest) covering default "system", persistence round-trip via localStorage, and initTheme applying/removing .dark for light/dark/system (mock matchMedia + document.documentElement). Add a component render test if feasible.

title: Verify lint, test, build
description: Run bun run lint, bun run test, bun run build across all touched files and confirm no type or build errors. Report results.

title: Generate PWA favicons and fix Manifest errors
description: Investigate https://github.com/itgalaxy/favicons via crawlberg MCP to determine the required favicon set and manifest structure. Locate the existing source asset and current PWA/manifest config. Generate all necessary favicon files and wire them into the manifest/HTML. Then use chrome-devtools MCP to inspect the Chrome DevTools Application > Manifest panel, diagnose errors, and fix them.

title: Path discovery: locate source asset + current manifest/PWA config
Fix Manifest errors via chrome-devtools MCP
Generate all favicon files and wire into manifest/HTML
Phase 1: Shopping-list panels
description: Implement Phase 1 main screen: two Ark UI Listbox panels (seeded catalog "all" + "selected" shopping list) wired to Nanostores. Store-driven indicators + onClick. Clicking a catalog item calls addToList; clicking a selected item calls removeFromList. Flat wrapped grid (no x-scroll). New components under src/components/, examples untouched.

title: Refactor ItemsPanel to Accordion layout
description: Replace the Field+Listbox layout in ItemsPanel with an Ark UI Accordion (multiple=true). Each category is an AccordionItem with an AccordionTrigger showing the category name and an AccordionContent that is a flex-wrap gap-2 container of item buttons. Each item button is variant 'default' when available (not in list) and 'outline' when selected (in list); clicking toggles membership via addToList/removeFromList. Preserve the public ItemsPanel API (default export, title prop) and the panel's vertical scroll behavior. ShoppingListPanel is out of scope.

title: Open all accordions by default in All items panel
description: Add defaultValue prop to Accordion component in ItemsPanel to expand all categories by default

title: Add defaultValue to Accordion in items-panel.tsx
Platform rollout: bff / web / admin modules (per docs/ROADMAP.md)
description: Grow the Bun workspace with @remindit/bff (PocketBase + Hono), @remindit/web (Rsbuild + TanStack Start) and @remindit/admin (Rsbuild + TanStack Start + Mantine). One feature branch per phase, verification gates + devdoc per phase. Source of truth: docs/ROADMAP.md (read it before starting any subtask).

title: Phase 0 — workspace foundations: root dev/typecheck scripts, .gitignore .env.example fix, root .env.example
Phase 1 — bff skeleton: Hono on Bun.serve, /pb/* SSE-capable proxy to PocketBase (pocketbase-bin), /api/health, pocketbase-mcp in opencode.jsonc, tests
Phase 2 — schema & migrations: PB collections from @remindit/common, idempotent fetch-diff-merge migrate script, API rules, bff/docs/SCHEMA.md
Phase 3 — auth & groups API: /api/auth/*, /api/groups/* with owner/member roles, notification stubs, bff/docs/API.md
Phase 4 — web marketing site: Rsbuild + TanStack Start, brand from common, /api/stats from BFF, web/README.md
Phase 5 — pwa sync: design doc first (pwa/docs/SYNC.md), auth UI, profile/items/categories/lists sync, offline queue, realtime
Phase 6 — admin (last priority): Rsbuild + TanStack Start + Mantine, login/registration, users + groups dashboards, admin role model
